notes.title: Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 Demo has Arrived— Play the Foundry Demo Today
notes.content:
Get shredding ahead of the game’s official July 11 release date with the arrival of the Foundry Demo* for [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i], launching June 8 and starring the Birdman himself alongside new skaters, two legendary skate parks, and a limited selection of songs to back your sick tricks.

Available to all players who pre-order the game with additional access to Game Pass users, the Foundry Demo is coming to PC (Battle.net, Steam, Microsoft PC Store).

The Foundry Demo begins June 8 at 11 AM PT for anyone who preorders [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i].
[h2][u]The Foundry Demo: Full Details[/u][/h2][h3]Up to Three Playable Skaters[/h3]
Tony Hawk leads a demo cast that’s joined by Rayssa Leal, a rising star from Brazil ready to rip it up in Foundry and College, who joins the roster of new skaters in the full release of [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i].

[b]Tony Hawk[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/3ad8f743d24fddb9028283c617b8a75fecf4daec.jpg[/img]
San Diego, California

Style: Vert / Stance: Goofy

Tony Hawk made history by landing the first ever 900 at the 1999 X Games, skyrocketing the sport into the mainstream. Today he remains the sport’s most iconic figure.

[b]Rayssa Leal[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/24c4f597010df774bbd2f1f5c5048a8d0239659d.jpg[/img]
Imperatriz, Brazil

Style: Street / Stance: Goofy

One of skateboarding’s youngest rising stars, Rayssa, earned a silver Olympic medal at age 13 and most recently won a bronze medal at the 2024 Summer Olympics.

[b]Doom Slayer[/b]

Earth, 7th Dimension

For players who pre-order the Digital Deluxe Edition version of the game, badass demon-hunting space marine Doom Slayer will be available as a third playable skater in the demo.
[h3]Two Legendary Parks[/h3]
Skate two classic parks: Foundry kicks off the [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 [/i]Skate Tour in the full game, while College kicks off the [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 4 [/i]Skate Tour. In the next-gen remake, the parks look better than ever, and these two are perfect for showing off the improvements that players will experience across the many more parks arriving at launch.

[b]Foundry[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/7319138791c585b200cf4ff7651624aec7edfeba.jpg[/img]
Turn up the heat in Foundry. The iconic map was featured as a demo level for the original [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3[/i], returning and remade in 4k resolution** in the Foundry Demo. Drop into the scorching factory heat and skate around the factory, catching air off ramps carved into the metal, grinding down the helix room, and maneuvering around molten environmental hazards deployed in the process of casting metal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/6103bd080b9f22f6ee8988d54b37cdc8664287d0.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/6cf84b0f43466cb8c8c3e9db538b12893419c072.jpg[/img]
[b]College[/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/07dc5236662de2d848044f9c4ce1e634769bab08.jpg[/img]
Kick it in Berkeley, California at the CCHU campus, home of the Chicken Hawks. Skate outside the stadium, combo tricks throughout the large student plaza, and even get up on top of the Ollie School of Art for some rooftop footwork. Balloons line the rails in celebration of the league champions, so amp up the party with tricks to inspire the student body.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/b10e2b2f59b92a7509a1311446551fdf09befc51.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/0f8463567f04535e504bed0dcf5993e34abe0250.jpg[/img]
[h2][u]Rock Out to the Soundtrack[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/c19b11f848baae244fbbd2fbfa7be34a5a262308.jpg[/img]
Get a taste of the full soundtrack with a limited selection of songs in the Foundry Demo, including CKY – 96 Quite Bitter Things; Del the Funky Homosapien – If You Must; Run the Jewels – yankee and the brave (ep. 4); Agent Orange – Everything Turns Grey; Motörhead – Ace of Spades; and Lupe Fiasco – Kick, Push. Read more about the soundtrack [url=https://www.tonyhawkthegame.com/blog/2025/06/tony-hawk-pro-skater-three-four-full-soundtrack]here[/url].
[h2][u]Get the Digital Deluxe Edition[/u][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/9e88ce07b9c667ff6605b60c06b48173befeec7e.jpg[/img]
Pre-order the Digital Deluxe Edition and skate as Doom Slayer in the Foundry Demo and in the full release of [i]Tony Hawk’s™ Pro Skater™ 3 + 4[/i]. Drop in July 8 three days*** before the official July 11 launch date and get additional in-game content, including:
[h3]Skate as Doom Slayer, Revenant[/h3]
Blast onto the scene with two special skaters Doom Slayer and Revenant, plus extra music, skate decks, and Create-A-Skater gear:
[list]	[*][b]Doom Slayer: [/b]Play as Doom Slayer, featuring a Standard and Retro outfit plus two unique special tricks and the Unmaykr Hoverboard. Doom Slayer will be playable in the Foundry Demo for players who pre-purchase the Digital Deluxe Edition in time for the demo.[/*]	[*][b]Revenant:[/b] Get evil with the Revenant, including 2 unique special tricks.[/*]	[*][b]Additional Music:[/b] Headbang to a selection of classic and modern tracks added to the in-game soundtrack.[/*]	[*][b]Skate Deck: [/b]Access additional skate decks including Doom Slayer and Revenant themed designs.[/*]	[*][b]Create-A-Skater Items: [/b]Kit out your skater with apparel items, including a baseball cap, sweatshirts, and T-shirts.[/*][/list]
[b][u]Pre-Order Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4 Today[/u][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44658694/008c51b0ddd2f7efabc96abd549c31d1ba7215db.jpg[/img]
Pre-orders are now available for [i]Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3 + 4[/i] on PC. For more information, visit [url=http://tonyhawkthegame.com/][b]tonyhawkthegame.com[/b][/url].

[i]* Foundry Demo available for pre-orders on PC.[/i]

[i]**4K output requires a 4K compatible device or display.[/i]

[i]***Actual play time subject to possible outages and applicable time zone differences.[/i]

notes.title: UPDATE: Surprise, Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4 officially revealed, along with a release date and a deluxe edition that'll make you shout 'Hell yeah' as you kickflip
notes.content:
UPDATE (04/03/25, 6:30 PM GMT): That timer's now run out, and Activision has officially revealed Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater 3+4. It's confirmed that July 11 release date, and the different stuff you'll get if you buy or pre-order a standard edition, a digital deluxe edition, or a collctor's edition that comes with a "limited-edition full-size Birdhouse skateboard deck".
